offering_description.value: GoodRx helps U.S. consumers compare prescription prices and redeem discounts at participating pharmacies through its website and app. It offers paid savings memberships and works with drugmakers to promote medications and help patients access them. It also offers online consultations for common conditions.

primary_services.value: prescription price comparison and discounts; paid prescription savings memberships; drugmaker marketing and patient access programs; online medical consultations

customer_segment.value: B2C: people shopping for prescription medications or seeking online medical consultations; B2B: pharmacy benefit managers, retail pharmacies and drug manufacturers

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: fees tied to prescriptions filled using GoodRx discounts; advertising: drugmaker campaigns that reach patients and healthcare professionals; subscription: monthly memberships for additional prescription discounts; service fees: drugmaker patient access programs and patient payments for online consultations
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; advertising; subscription; service fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: aggregates prescription prices and discounts from pharmacy partners for consumers and connects drugmakers with patients and clinicians; service provider: connects patients seeking routine care with licensed clinicians for online consultations

geography_served.value: US national: United States nationwide through a network of participating pharmacies

specialization.value: related lines: prescription discounts, savings memberships, drugmaker marketing and patient access programs, and telehealth

distribution_channels.value: online: GoodRx website and mobile app; partners / resellers: participating pharmacies redeem discounts and benefit partners offer savings through their programs; direct sales: commercial teams sell marketing and patient access programs to drug manufacturers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: FTC health-data and advertising rules, state privacy laws, and state clinician licensing rules for telehealth

notes: The current scope of GoodRx’s standalone telehealth offering is uncertain.
